_about: What the PROJECT PROPOSAL / PROFILE task page shows. One file per form (user, 2026-10-07): change this file to change what the page shows - no code change. Read by IRSTasks through the `fields` key of the subtype's entry in js/config/TaskFields.js.
_generated: Generated on 2026-10-07 from IRSProjects/js/config/ProjectForm.js, whose source of truth is WP02 doc 05 section 12 - every field verified in MQL on 2026-09-23. Hand edits are expected from now on; if doc 05 changes, check both this file and ProjectForm.js.

_source.project: read from the PROJECT's dataelements - the proposal form is almost entirely project data, which is why this page calls the project
_source.task: read from the TASK's own dataelements (this form has none - EPMPROJECT_PROPOSAL carries no custom attribute, measured 2026-10-07)
_source.none: not a value: it lives in a relationship, in its own objects, in the WBS or in the approval route. The page shows the note instead of an empty box, because an empty box reads as 'nothing was entered'.

_hidden: A field with "hidden": true is not drawn at all - not resolved, not counted, and its $include section is not fetched. This is how a row is commented out (user, 2026-10-08: 'as of now remove these column just comment the code later when required we will show them'). The four currently hidden are the ones that have no value to show yet: XVI lives in the WBS, and the three signatures are collected by the approval route. Delete the one line to bring a row back. The screening-approval row was the fifth until 2026-10-27, when DMC created EPMScreeningApprovalObtained.
_profiles: A field with "profileField": "<key>" is printed on one area's paper form only, and is shown only when the project's Department is in one of that key's profiles. The departments and the key-to-profile map are in page IRSProjectFormProfiles, read by the REST service with the department section - the same page and the same keys the AEF project form uses through its IRS Profile Field setting, so the two cannot disagree. No department yet: none of these rows. R&D (RND) sees VIII-XIII; RDAREA (AR) sees Resources and Required competence / skill instead, in RDAREA-PRJ-01-Rev.01's order (VII, VIII before Methodology). Worklog 2026-10-27-02 / -03, WP02 doc 14.

_display.longtext: prose - the form asks for paragraphs here
_display.pending: agreed but NOT created on the platform yet: the page says so rather than showing it as empty
_display.elsewhere: see the note - another object or tab owns it
_display.approval: an approval signature - a route task, not a field
_display.type: carried by the project's type itself

title: PROJECT PROPOSAL / PROFILE

fields.label: Project Name
fields.note: The project's name. On R2024x a project is created with a name only, so Title stays empty - this is the field, not a fallback

fields.label: Project No.
fields.note: System generated from a numbering scheme (R20) - the scheme is not defined yet

fields.label: Department
fields.note: The Department linked by IRSDepartmentProject, with the Business Unit that owns it (relationship Company Department) - the stream the project belongs to

fields.label: Project Category
fields.note: Research or Analysis - carried by the project subtype itself, shown with the platform's own display name (the nlsType field)

fields.label: Customer Name and Contact
fields.note: The customer linked by IRSProjectCustomer. An EXTERNAL project's customer is a Company and carries an e-mail address; an INTERNAL project's is a Business Unit or a Department, which has none - the attribute is on Company only, so the rows differ by kind

fields.label: Input – Technical Data, Information and References
Complexity of the design and development activity (applicable only for design and development of new product/service)
Identified Standards, Codes, Acts, Rules, Regulations, Statutory and legal requirements, etc. along with its version/year as applicable
fields.note: with version or year, as applicable

fields.label: Feedback from previous similar design (applicable only for design and development of new product/service)
Potential consequences of failure (applicable only for design and development of new product/service)
Lessons learnt from failures (applicable only for design and development of new product/service)
fields.note: The Lessons Learnt from Failures (IRSLessonLearnt) created in this project, every state, two columns as on the PDF - no From project column (user, 2026-10-23; worklog 2026-10-23-02/-04). Key Learnings (IRSLearning) are no longer shown here

fields.label: Risks and opportunities (Please specify if other than identified in Chap 8: III R&D)
fields.note: The OOTB Risk and Opportunity objects linked by the Risk relationship. Read through our own REST service: the OOTB risk list returns empty for these, and Opportunity has no OOTB route at all (worklog 2026-10-07-03)

fields.label: Details of stage-validation, verification and validation (if applicable)
Project Planning: Task break-up, sequencing, Review Stages and stage-validation, verification and validation stages (Refer to sample format: Page 2 of R&D-PRJ-02)
fields.note: The OOTB work breakdown - Subtask, Task, Phase, Gate, Milestone

fields.label: Approval from Screening Committee is obtained
fields.note: Yes / No / Not_Applicable - a range attribute, created in DMC 2026-10-27; on both areas' forms

fields.label: Project Manager
fields.note: An approval signature - collected by the route task when the approver acts, not typed into the form.
